policy: For Mercury-custom Megas, prefer an existing matched front/back sprite set with clear attribution over redrawing. Redraw only if no coherent source pair can be found.

entries.name: Mega Roserade
entries.note: This is a deliberately paired front/back set used in-game by Emerald Imperium. Use it as the new source candidate instead of the mismatched Banished/ER archive pair.

entries.name: Mega Milotic
entries.note: Complete front/back/icon/palette package found. This is a stronger integration candidate than the mismatched archive sources and avoids a redraw unless DS-scale review fails.

entries.name: Mega Spiritomb
entries.note: The ugly Mercury archive result is a downscaled conversion of a much larger original Banished Platinum sprite. Recover the original public-resource image and perform a deliberate DS conversion instead of redrawing the design.
entries.source_repository: Eevee Expo resource 651: Free to Use Mega Evolutions v1.0.0

entries.name: Mega Magmortar
entries.note: The current archive sprite was both palette-quantized and heavily scaled. Recover the original public-resource art, then hand-convert it to the DS palette/size rather than redrawing or using the degraded conversion.
entries.source_repository: Eevee Expo resource 651: Free to Use Mega Evolutions v1.0.0

archive_conversion_evidence.conversion_notes: palette quantized 28->15; art_fit_scaled; missing shiny frames

next_action: Recover original Banished Platinum Mega Spiritomb and Mega Magmortar assets from the public Eevee Expo resource, then perform controlled DS conversions. Roserade and Milotic already have stronger matched sprite packages.
